# Rapid-MLX benchmark receipts

Raw JSON receipts from real `rapid-mlx` runs (TTFT, Metal peak memory,
evictions, retained cache bytes), generated by
`scripts/rapid-mlx-benchmark-suite.mjs` and `scripts/model-runtime-benchmark.mjs`.
Not read by `cargo test` or any CI path — the calibration constants in
`src/llama/vram_estimator/rapid_slopes.rs` were hand-derived from reading
these once and are now hardcoded, not sourced at runtime.

## Canonical (cited in docs)

These receipts back specific claims in `docs/reference/*.md` or
`docs/archive/rapid-mlx/*.md` — treat them as the trustworthy baseline:

- `ailexleon-gemma4-26b-lm-source-5fc6556c-cache-stage0/`
- `gemma4-12b-qat-4bit-m5max-64gb-0.10.17.json`
- `gemma4-26b-a4b-qat-q4-aligned-m5max-64gb-0.10.17.json`
- `qwen36-35b-a3b-m5max-64gb-0.10.17.json`
- `qwen35-9b-defiant-all-088-markers/`
- `qwen35-9b-defiant-tools-froggeric/`
- `qwen35-9b-defiant-tools-froggeric-32k-r16k/`
- `qwen35-9b-prefill-512/`

- `unsloth-qwen36-35b-source-5fc6556c-cache-stage0-exact512-v2/`

- `unsloth-qwen36-35b-workspace-cache-disk-200k-int4-8g-v1/`

## Everything else

The remaining directories are exploratory runs (vision smoke tests,
TurboQuant scale probes, kv-gate variants, per-architecture context probes)
that never made it into a published table. They're kept as raw baseline
data for comparing against future runtime integrations (e.g. the planned
MTPLX loader) — not because every run is individually load-bearing.

Literal reruns of an identical experiment where a later run superseded an
earlier one with no new information have been pruned (e.g. old
`image-context-v1/v3`, `kv-gate-repeat`, non-`v2` `workspace-cache-131k-8g`).
